dashboard.label: SGB - Feed Sağlığı
dashboard.description: UC-XX-004'ün görsel karşılığı: TAXII ingest durumu, indicator sayısı tarihçesi ve ani düşüş kontrolü. Feed sağlığı diğer tüm kuralların ön koşuludur.

search.query: | tstats max(_indextime) AS last_ingest, count AS events WHERE `sgb_ti_index` BY source | eval lag_min=round((now()-last_ingest)/60, 0), last_ingest=strftime(last_ingest, "%F %T") | eval durum=case(lag_min<=120, "OK", lag_min<=360, "GECİKMELİ", true(), "DURMUŞ") | table source, events, last_ingest, lag_min, durum
| inputlookup sgb_feed_count_history | eval _time=_time | timechart span=1h latest(n) by feed

panel.title: Ani düşüş kontrolü (son iki snapshot, eşik %20)

search.query: | inputlookup sgb_feed_count_history | sort - _time | streamstats count AS rank by feed | where rank<=2 | stats latest(n) AS son, earliest(n) AS onceki by feed | eval degisim_pct=round(100*(son-onceki)/onceki, 1) | eval durum=if(degisim_pct<-20, "DÜŞÜŞ — incele (UC-XX-004)", "OK") | table feed, onceki, son, degisim_pct, durum
| inputlookup sgb_indicators | stats count by source | sort - count
